for the Lord will be your confidence
    and will keep your foot from being caught.
texts.LEB:
Yahweh will be your confidence
    and guard your foot from capture.

texts.NIV84: Do not withhold good from those who deserve it, when it is in your power to act.
texts.KJV: Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do it.
texts.NASB95:
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due,
When it is in your power to do it.
texts.NKJV:
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due,
When it is in the power of your hand to do so.
texts.DRB: Do not withhold him from doing good, who is able: if thou art able, do good thyself also.
texts.ESV:
Do not withhold good from those to whom it is due,
    when it is in your power to do it.
texts.LEB:
Do not withhold good from its owner
    when it is in the power of your hand to do.

texts.NIV84: Do not say to your neighbor, "Come back later; I'll give it tomorrow"- when you now have it with you.
texts.KJV: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
texts.NASB95:
Do not say to your neighbor, “Go, and come back,
And tomorrow I will give it,”
When you have it with you.
texts.NKJV:
Do not say to your neighbor,
“Go, and come back,
And tomorrow I will give it,”
When you have it with you.
texts.DRB: Say not to thy friend: Go, and come again: and to morrow I will give to thee: when thou canst give at present.
texts.ESV:
Do not say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again,
    tomorrow I will give it”—when you have it with you.
texts.LEB:
Do not say to your neighbor,
    “Go and return and tomorrow I will give it,”
    when it is with you.

texts.NIV84: Do not plot harm against your neighbor, who lives trustfully near you.
texts.KJV: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
texts.NASB95:
Do not devise harm against your neighbor,
While he lives securely beside you.
texts.NKJV:
Do not devise evil against your neighbor,
For he dwells by you for safety’s sake.
texts.DRB: Practise not evil against thy friend, when he hath confidence in thee.
texts.ESV:
Do not plan evil against your neighbor,
    who dwells trustingly beside you.
texts.LEB:
Do not plot harm against your neighbor
    who dwells in confidence beside you.

texts.NIV84: Do not accuse a man for no reason- when he has done you no harm.
texts.KJV: Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
texts.NASB95:
Do not contend with a man without cause,
If he has done you no harm.
texts.NKJV:
Do not strive with a man without cause,
If he has done you no harm.
texts.DRB: Strive not against a man without cause, when he hath done thee no evil.
texts.ESV:
Do not contend with a man for no reason,
    when he has done you no harm.
texts.LEB:
Do not quarrel with anyone without cause,
    when he did not do you harm.

texts.NIV84: Do not envy a violent man or choose any of his ways,
texts.KJV: Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
texts.NASB95:
Do not envy a man of violence
And do not choose any of his ways.
texts.NKJV:
Do not envy the oppressor,
And choose none of his ways;
texts.DRB: Envy not the unjust man, and do not follow his ways:
texts.ESV:
Do not envy a man of violence
    and do not choose any of his ways,
texts.LEB:
Do not envy a man of violence,
    and do not choose any of his ways,

texts.NIV84: for the LORD detests a perverse man but takes the upright into his confidence.
texts.KJV: For the froward is abomination to the Lord: but his secret is with the righteous.
texts.NASB95:
For the devious are an abomination to the Lord;
But He is intimate with the upright.
texts.NKJV:
For the perverse person is an abomination to the Lord,
But His secret counsel is with the upright.
texts.DRB: For every mocker is an abomination to the Lord, and his communication is with the simple.
texts.ESV:
for the devious person is an abomination to the Lord,
    but the upright are in his confidence.
texts.LEB:
for he who is perverse is an abomination of Yahweh,
    but those who are upright are his confidence.

texts.NIV84: The LORD's curse is on the house of the wicked, but he blesses the home of the righteous.
texts.KJV: The curse of the Lord is in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
texts.NASB95:
The curse of the Lord is on the house of the wicked,
But He blesses the dwelling of the righteous.
texts.NKJV:
The curse of the Lord is on the house of the wicked,
But He blesses the home of the just.
texts.DRB: Want is from the Lord in the house of the wicked: but the habitations of the just shall be blessed.
texts.ESV:
The Lord's curse is on the house of the wicked,
    but he blesses the dwelling of the righteous.
texts.LEB:
The curse of Yahweh is on the house of the wicked,
    and the abode of the righteous ones he blesses.

texts.NIV84: He mocks proud mockers but gives grace to the humble.
texts.KJV: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
texts.NASB95:
Though He scoffs at the scoffers,
Yet He gives grace to the afflicted.
texts.NKJV:
Surely He scorns the scornful,
But gives grace to the humble.
texts.DRB: He shall scorn the scorners, and to the meek he will give grace.
texts.ESV:
Toward the scorners he is scornful,
    but to the humble he gives favor.
texts.LEB:
With those who scorn, he is scornful,
    but to those who are humble, he gives favor.

texts.NIV84: The wise inherit honor, but fools he holds up to shame.
texts.KJV: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
texts.NASB95:
The wise will inherit honor,
But fools display dishonor.
texts.NKJV:
The wise shall inherit glory,
But shame shall be the legacy of fools.
texts.DRB: The wise shall possess glory: the promotion of fools is disgrace.
texts.ESV:
The wise will inherit honor,
    but fools get disgrace.
texts.LEB:
They will inherit the honor of the wise,
    but stubborn fools, disgrace.

texts.NIV84: Listen, my sons, to a father's instruction; pay attention and gain understanding.
texts.KJV: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend to know understanding.
texts.NASB95:
Hear, O sons, the instruction of a father,
And give attention that you may gain understanding,
texts.NKJV:
Hear, my children, the instruction of a father,
And give attention to know understanding;
texts.DRB: Hear, ye children, the instruction of a father, and attend that you may know prudence.
texts.ESV:
Hear, O sons, a father's instruction,
    and be attentive, that you may gain insight,
texts.LEB:
Children, listen to the instruction of a father,
    and be attentive in order to know insight.

texts.NIV84: I give you sound learning, so do not forsake my teaching.
texts.KJV: For I give you good doctrine, forsake ye not my law.
texts.NASB95:
For I give you sound teaching;
Do not abandon my instruction.
texts.NKJV:
For I give you good doctrine:
Do not forsake my law.
texts.DRB: I will give you a good gift, forsake not my law.
texts.ESV:
for I give you good precepts;
    do not forsake my teaching.
texts.LEB:
For I have given you good instruction;
    do not forsake my teaching.

texts.NIV84: When I was a boy in my father's house, still tender, and an only child of my mother,
texts.KJV: For I was my father's son, tender and only beloved in the sight of my mother.
texts.NASB95:
When I was a son to my father,
Tender and the only son in the sight of my mother,
texts.NKJV:
When I was my father’s son,
Tender and the only one in the sight of my mother,
texts.DRB: For I also was my father's son, tender and as an only son in the sight of my mother:
texts.ESV:
When I was a son with my father,
    tender, the only one in the sight of my mother,
texts.LEB:
When I was a son to my father,
    tender and alone before my mother,

texts.NIV84: he taught me and said, "Lay hold of my words with all your heart; keep my commands and you will live.
texts.KJV: He taught me also, and said unto me, Let thine heart retain my words: keep my commandments, and live.
texts.DRB: And he taught me, and said: Let thy heart receive my words, keep my commandments, and thou shalt live.

blocks.title: Get Wisdom for She is Your Life

texts.NIV84: Get wisdom, get understanding; do not forget my words or swerve from them.
texts.KJV: Get wisdom, get understanding: forget it not; neither decline from the words of my mouth.
texts.NASB95:
Acquire wisdom! Acquire understanding!
Do not forget nor turn away from the words of my mouth.
texts.NKJV:
Get wisdom! Get understanding!
Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.
texts.DRB: Get wisdom, get prudence: forget not, neither decline from the words of my mouth.
texts.ESV:
Get wisdom; get insight;
    do not forget, and do not turn away from the words of my mouth.
texts.LEB:
Get wisdom and insight;
    do not forget and do not turn from the sayings of my mouth.

texts.NIV84: Do not forsake wisdom, and she will protect you; love her, and she will watch over you.
texts.KJV: Forsake her not, and she shall preserve thee: love her, and she shall keep thee.
texts.NASB95:
“Do not forsake her, and she will guard you;
Love her, and she will watch over you.
texts.NKJV:
Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you;
Love her, and she will keep you.
texts.DRB: Forsake her not, and she shall keep thee: love her, and she shall preserve thee.
texts.ESV:
Do not forsake her, and she will keep you;
    love her, and she will guard you.
texts.LEB:
Do not forsake her—then she will guard you;
    love her and she will keep you.

texts.NIV84: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom. Though it cost all you have, get understanding.
texts.KJV: Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.
texts.NASB95:
“The beginning of wisdom is: Acquire wisdom;
And with all your acquiring, get understanding.
texts.DRB: The beginning of wisdom, get wisdom, and with all thy possession purchase prudence.
texts.ESV:
The beginning of wisdom is this: Get wisdom,
    and whatever you get, get insight.
texts.LEB:
The beginning of wisdom: Get wisdom!
    With all that is in your possession, gain insight.

texts.NIV84: Esteem her, and she will exalt you; embrace her, and she will honor you.
texts.KJV: Exalt her, and she shall promote thee: she shall bring thee to honour, when thou dost embrace her.
texts.NASB95:
“Prize her, and she will exalt you;
She will honor you if you embrace her.
texts.NKJV:
Exalt her, and she will promote you;
She will bring you honor, when you embrace her.
texts.DRB: Take hold on her, and she shall exalt thee: thou shalt be glorified by her, when thou shalt embrace her.
texts.ESV:
Prize her highly, and she will exalt you;
    she will honor you if you embrace her.
texts.LEB:
Cherish her and she will exalt you;
    she will honor you if you embrace her.

texts.NIV84: She will set a garland of grace on your head and present you with a crown of splendor."
texts.KJV: She shall give to thine head an ornament of grace: a crown of glory shall she deliver to thee.
texts.NASB95:
“She will place on your head a garland of grace;
She will present you with a crown of beauty.”
texts.NKJV:
She will place on your head an ornament of grace;
A crown of glory she will deliver to you.”
texts.DRB: She shall give to thy head increase of graces, and protect thee with a noble crown.
texts.ESV:
She will place on your head a graceful garland;
    she will bestow on you a beautiful crown.”
texts.LEB:
She will give a garland for your head;
    she shall bestow a crown of glory upon you.”

texts.NIV84: Listen, my son, accept what I say, and the years of your life will be many.
texts.KJV: Hear, O my son, and receive my sayings; and the years of thy life shall be many.
texts.NASB95:
Hear, my son, and accept my sayings
And the years of your life will be many.
texts.NKJV:
Hear, my son, and receive my sayings,
And the years of your life will be many.
texts.DRB: Hear, O my son, and receive my words, that years of life may be multiplied to thee.
texts.ESV:
Hear, my son, and accept my words,
    that the years of your life may be many.
texts.LEB:
Listen, my child, take my sayings,
    and the years of your life shall be great.

texts.NIV84: I guide you in the way of wisdom and lead you along straight paths.
texts.KJV: I have taught thee in the way of wisdom; I have led thee in right paths.
texts.NASB95:
I have directed you in the way of wisdom;
I have led you in upright paths.
texts.NKJV:
I have taught you in the way of wisdom;
I have led you in right paths.
texts.DRB: I will shew thee the way of wisdom, I will lead thee by the paths of equity:
texts.ESV:
I have taught you the way of wisdom;
    I have led you in the paths of uprightness.
texts.LEB:
In the way of wisdom I have instructed you;
    I have led you in the path of uprightness.

texts.NIV84: When you walk, your steps will not be hampered; when you run, you will not stumble.
texts.KJV: When thou goest, thy steps shall not be straitened; and when thou runnest, thou shalt not stumble.
texts.NASB95:
When you walk, your steps will not be impeded;
And if you run, you will not stumble.
texts.NKJV:
When you walk, your steps will not be hindered,
And when you run, you will not stumble.
texts.DRB: Which when thou shalt have entered, thy steps shall not be straitened, and when thou runnest thou shalt not meet a stumblingblock.
texts.ESV:
When you walk, your step will not be hampered,
    and if you run, you will not stumble.
texts.LEB:
When you walk, your step will not be hampered,
    and if you run, you will not stumble.

texts.NIV84: Hold on to instruction, do not let it go; guard it well, for it is your life.
texts.KJV: Take fast hold of instruction; let her not go: keep her; for she is thy life.
texts.NASB95:
Take hold of instruction; do not let go.
Guard her, for she is your life.
texts.NKJV:
Take firm hold of instruction, do not let go;
Keep her, for she is your life.
texts.DRB: Take hold on instruction, leave it not: keep it, because it is thy life.
texts.ESV:
Keep hold of instruction; do not let go;
    guard her, for she is your life.
texts.LEB:
Seize the instruction! Do not let go!
    Guard her, for she is your life.

texts.NIV84: Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evil men.
texts.KJV: Enter not into the path of the wicked, and go not in the way of evil men.
texts.NASB95:
Do not enter the path of the wicked
And do not proceed in the way of evil men.
texts.NKJV:
Do not enter the path of the wicked,
And do not walk in the way of evil.
texts.DRB: Be not delighted in the paths of the wicked, neither let the way of evil men please thee.
texts.ESV:
Do not enter the path of the wicked,
    and do not walk in the way of the evil.
texts.LEB:
In the path of the wicked do not go;
    do not walk in the way of those who do evil.

texts.NIV84: Avoid it, do not travel on it; turn from it and go on your way.
texts.KJV: Avoid it, pass not by it, turn from it, and pass away.
texts.NASB95:
Avoid it, do not pass by it;
Turn away from it and pass on.
texts.NKJV:
Avoid it, do not travel on it;
Turn away from it and pass on.
texts.DRB: Flee from it, pass not by it: go aside, and forsake it.
texts.ESV:
Avoid it; do not go on it;
    turn away from it and pass on.
texts.LEB:
Avoid it; do not transgress it;
    turn away from it and pass by.

texts.NIV84: For they cannot sleep till they do evil; they are robbed of slumber till they make someone fall.
texts.KJV: For they sleep not, except they have done mischief; and their sleep is taken away, unless they cause some to fall.
texts.NASB95:
For they cannot sleep unless they do evil;
And they are robbed of sleep unless they make someone stumble.
texts.NKJV:
For they do not sleep unless they have done evil;
And their sleep is taken away unless they make someone fall.
texts.DRB: For they sleep not except they have done evil: and their sleep is taken away unless they have made some to fall.
texts.ESV:
For they cannot sleep unless they have done wrong;
    they are robbed of sleep unless they have made someone stumble.
texts.LEB:
For they will not sleep if they have not done wrong,
    and they are robbed of their sleep if they do not cause stumbling.

texts.NIV84: They eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.
texts.KJV: For they eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of violence.
texts.NASB95:
For they eat the bread of wickedness
And drink the wine of violence.
texts.NKJV:
For they eat the bread of wickedness,
And drink the wine of violence.
texts.DRB: They eat the bread of wickedness, and drink the wine of iniquity.
texts.ESV:
For they eat the bread of wickedness
    and drink the wine of violence.
texts.LEB:
For they ate the bread of wickedness,
    and they drank the wine of violence.

texts.NIV84: The path of the righteous is like the first gleam of dawn, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.
texts.KJV: But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day.
texts.NASB95:
But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn,
That shines brighter and brighter until the full day.
texts.NKJV:
But the path of the just is like the shining sun,
That shines ever brighter unto the perfect day.
texts.DRB: But the path of the just, as a shining light, goeth forwards and increaseth even to perfect day.
texts.ESV:
But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn,
    which shines brighter and brighter until full day.
texts.LEB:
But the path of the righteous ones is like the light of dawn,
    leading and shining until the day is full.

texts.NIV84: But the way of the wicked is like deep darkness; they do not know what makes them stumble.
texts.KJV: The way of the wicked is as darkness: they know not at what they stumble.
texts.NASB95:
The way of the wicked is like darkness;
They do not know over what they stumble.
texts.NKJV:
The way of the wicked is like darkness;
They do not know what makes them stumble.
texts.DRB: The way of the wicked is darksome: they know not where they fall.
texts.ESV:
The way of the wicked is like deep darkness;
    they do not know over what they stumble.
texts.LEB:
The way of the wicked ones is like deep darkness;
    they do not know what they stumble over.

blocks.title: Watch & Guard Eyes, Ears and Heart

texts.NIV84: My son, pay attention to what I say; listen closely to my words.
texts.KJV: My son, attend to my words; incline thine ear unto my sayings.
texts.NASB95:
My son, give attention to my words;
Incline your ear to my sayings.
texts.NKJV:
My son, give attention to my words;
Incline your ear to my sayings.
texts.DRB: My son, hearken to my words, and incline thy ear to my sayings.
texts.ESV:
My son, be attentive to my words;
    incline your ear to my sayings.
texts.LEB:
My child, be attentive to my words;
    to my sayings incline your ear.

texts.NIV84: Do not let them out of your sight, keep them within your heart;
texts.KJV: Let them not depart from thine eyes; keep them in the midst of thine heart.
texts.NASB95:
Do not let them depart from your sight;
Keep them in the midst of your heart.
texts.NKJV:
Do not let them depart from your eyes;
Keep them in the midst of your heart;
texts.DRB: Let them not depart from thy eyes, keep them in the midst of thy heart:
texts.ESV:
Let them not escape from your sight;
    keep them within your heart.
texts.LEB:
May they not escape from your sight;
    keep them in the midst of your heart.

texts.NIV84: for they are life to those who find them and health to a man's whole body.
texts.KJV: For they are life unto those that find them, and health to all their flesh.
texts.NASB95:
For they are life to those who find them
And health to all their body.
texts.NKJV:
For they are life to those who find them,
And health to all their flesh.
texts.DRB: For they are life to those that find them, and health to all flesh.
texts.ESV:
For they are life to those who find them,
    and healing to all their flesh.
texts.LEB:
For they are life to those who find them
    and healing to the entire body.

texts.NIV84: Above all else, guard your heart, for it is the wellspring of life.
texts.KJV: Keep thy heart with all diligence; for out of it are the issues of life.
texts.NASB95:
Watch over your heart with all diligence,
For from it flow the springs of life.
texts.NKJV:
Keep your heart with all diligence,
For out of it spring the issues of life.
texts.DRB: With all watchfulness keep thy heart, because life issueth out from it.
texts.ESV:
Keep your heart with all vigilance,
    for from it flow the springs of life.
texts.LEB:
With all vigilance, keep your heart,
    for from it comes the source of life.

texts.NIV84: Put away perversity from your mouth; keep corrupt talk far from your lips.
texts.KJV: Put away from thee a froward mouth, and perverse lips put far from thee.
texts.NASB95:
Put away from you a deceitful mouth
And put devious speech far from you.
texts.NKJV:
Put away from you a deceitful mouth,
And put perverse lips far from you.
texts.DRB: Remove from thee a froward mouth, and let detracting lips be far from thee.
texts.ESV:
Put away from you crooked speech,
    and put devious talk far from you.
texts.LEB:
Remove from yourself deceitful speech,
    and abolish devious talk from yourself.

texts.NIV84: Let your eyes look straight ahead, fix your gaze directly before you.
texts.KJV: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
texts.NASB95:
Let your eyes look directly ahead
And let your gaze be fixed straight in front of you.
texts.NKJV:
Let your eyes look straight ahead,
And your eyelids look right before you.
texts.DRB: Let thy eyes look straight on, and let thy eyelids go before thy steps.
texts.ESV:
Let your eyes look directly forward,
    and your gaze be straight before you.
texts.LEB:
May your eyes look forward
    and your gaze be straight before you.

texts.NIV84: Make level paths for your feet and take only ways that are firm.
texts.KJV: Ponder the path of thy feet, and let all thy ways be established.
texts.NASB95:
Watch the path of your feet
And all your ways will be established.
texts.NKJV:
Ponder the path of your feet,
And let all your ways be established.
texts.DRB: Make straight the path for thy feet, and all thy ways shall be established.
texts.ESV:
Ponder the path of your feet;
    then all your ways will be sure.
texts.LEB:
May the path of your foot be balanced
    and all your ways be sure.

texts.NIV84: Do not swerve to the right or the left; keep your foot from evil.
texts.KJV: Turn not to the right hand nor to the left: remove thy foot from evil.
texts.NASB95:
Do not turn to the right nor to the left;
Turn your foot from evil.
texts.NKJV:
Do not turn to the right or the left;
Remove your foot from evil.
texts.DRB: Decline not to the right hand, nor to the left: turn away thy foot from evil. For the Lord knoweth the ways that are on the right hand: but those are perverse which are on the left hand. But he will make thy courses straight, he will bring forward thy ways in peace.
texts.ESV:
Do not swerve to the right or to the left;
    turn your foot away from evil.
texts.LEB:
Do not swerve right or left;
    remove your foot from evil.

texts.NIV84: My son, keep my words and store up my commands within you.
texts.KJV: My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.
texts.NASB95:
My son, keep my words
And treasure my commandments within you.
texts.NKJV:
My son, keep my words,
And treasure my commands within you.
texts.DRB: My son, keep my words, and lay up my precepts with thee. Son,
texts.ESV:
My son, keep my words
    and treasure up my commandments with you;
texts.LEB:
My child, guard my sayings;
    store my commandments with you.

texts.NIV84: Keep my commands and you will live; guard my teachings as the apple of your eye.
texts.KJV: Keep my commandments, and live; and my law as the apple of thine eye.
texts.NASB95:
Keep my commandments and live,
And my teaching as the apple of your eye.
texts.NKJV:
Keep my commands and live,
And my law as the apple of your eye.
texts.DRB: Keep my commandments, and thou shalt live: and my law as the apple of thy eye:
texts.ESV:
keep my commandments and live;
    keep my teaching as the apple of your eye;
texts.LEB:
Keep my commands and live,
    and my teaching like the apple of your eye.

texts.NIV84: Bind them on your fingers; write them on the tablet of your heart.
texts.KJV: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the table of thine heart.
texts.NASB95:
Bind them on your fingers;
Write them on the tablet of your heart.
texts.NKJV:
Bind them on your fingers;
Write them on the tablet of your heart.
texts.DRB: Bind it upon thy fingers, write it upon the tables of thy heart.
